source: Hand-assembled from the public layouts of channel 2 messages for file services. Not captured from a client and not produced by a server. The two Get File proposals named for a client shape are assembled from an assumed layout; the one to the host carries tag 0x2711 as AIM 5.1 writes it.

vectors.name: send-file proposal, relay address
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the client, from Alice. Tags 0x02 and 0x04 hold 203.0.113.7, tag 0x03 holds 192.168.1.20, port 5190, one file of 90112 bytes.

vectors.name: send-file counter-offer, sequence 2
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the client, from Alice. Address 198.51.100.9, port 4443, no tag 0x2711.

vectors.name: send-file accept to client
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the client, from Alice. The 26-byte head only.

vectors.name: send-file cancel to client, reason 1
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the client, from Alice.

vectors.name: send-file proposal to host, to bob, one file
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the host. Tags 0x0A, 0x0F, 0x02, 0x16, 0x03, 0x05, 0x17, 0x2711 in that order, then the empty tag 0x03.

vectors.name: send-file accept to host, to Alice
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the host. The 26-byte head only.

vectors.name: send-file cancel to host, to Alice, reason 1
client error body, channel 2, from Alice, code 1
direct-im proposal, 5.1 shape
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the client, from Alice. Tags 0x0A, 0x0F, 0x03, 0x05 only: the layout of an older client. Address 203.0.113.7, port 5190.

vectors.name: direct-im proposal, 5.9 shape
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the client, from Alice. Tags 0x0A, 0x0F, then 0x02, 0x16, 0x03, 0x05, 0x17: the layout of a later client. Address 203.0.113.7, port 5190.

vectors.name: direct-im proposal to host, to bob
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. To the host. Tags 0x0A, 0x0F, 0x02, 0x16, 0x03, 0x05, 0x17 in that order, no tag 0x2711, then the empty tag 0x03.

vectors.name: get-file proposal, 5.1 shape
vectors.note: Hand-assembled from the assumed layout. To the client, from Alice. Tags 0x0A, 0x0F, 0x03, 0x05 only: the layout of an older client. Address 203.0.113.7, port 5190, no file block.

vectors.name: get-file proposal, 5.9 shape
vectors.note: Hand-assembled from the assumed layout. To the client, from Alice. Tags 0x0A, 0x0F, then 0x02, 0x16, 0x03, 0x05, 0x17: the layout of a later client. Address 203.0.113.7, port 5190, no file block.

vectors.name: get-file proposal to host, to bob
vectors.note: Hand-assembled. The tags of a Direct IM proposal, then tag 0x2711 as AIM 5.1 writes it in its own Get File proposal.
